ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the diagram, point $D$ is the midpoint of segment $AC$, and point $E$ is the midpoint of segment $BC$, with $BC=\frac{4}{7}AC$. If $BC=8$, what is the length of $DC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $BC=8$ and $BC=\frac{4}{7}AC$,\\
it follows that $AC=8\div\frac{4}{7}=14$,\\
Given that point $D$ is the midpoint of line segment $AC$,\\
it follows that $DC=\frac{1}{2}AC=\frac{1}{2}\times 14=\boxed{7}$.
